commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
90+2' The opposition back off Juan Cruz (Leganes) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies over the bar. Unlucky!
90+1' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Renato Tapia (Leganes) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' That was close by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
84' OFF THE POST! Diego Garcia (Leganes) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
84' Leganes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
80' Borja Jimenez prepares a substitution. Roberto Lopez is replaced by Munir El Haddadi (Leganes).
80' The substitution has been made. Diego Garcia (Leganes) has replaced Sebastien Haller.
79' Leganes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Leganes.
75' 0 - 2 Spectacular goal! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
74' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
72' Substitution. Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro will be replaced by Renato Tapia (Leganes).
72' Here is a change. Darko Brasanac is going off and Borja Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Juan Cruz (Leganes).
71' The corner is swung in but Leganes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' Celebrations are cut short for Leganes as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
68' Wait! Referee Francisco Maeso has indicated he is going to review the Leganes goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
65' 0 - 1 Goal! Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 0:1.
65' Ath Bilbao work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

65' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
65' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
64' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
63' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Valentin Rosier (Leganes) for his blatant foul.
63' Substitution. Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) on for Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
62' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' A substitution has been made. Mikel Vesga is replaced by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
57' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) replacing Unai Gomez.
56' Substitution. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) has come on for Alvaro Djalo.
56' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

53' A lofted cross from Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
49' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
48' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Ernesto Valverde Tejedor probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Nico Williams. He is replaced by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' The corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by the defence.
43' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
41' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
40' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
37' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Juan Soriano intercepts the ball.
36' The ball is cleared after Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
33' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
32' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Ath Bilbao was in an offside position.
31' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
25' Ath Bilbao are ruled offside.
22' Chance! Sebastien Haller (Leganes) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the top of the net, but Julen Agirrezabala is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
21' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
20' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) sends a long ball in, but Julen Agirrezabala comfortably gathers the ball.
19' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but Juan Soriano punches the ball away.
14' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Francisco Maeso blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Leganes.
14' Sebastien Haller (Leganes) climbs high to connect with a cross heading towards the edge of the box and produces a poor header which goes well wide of the right post.
12' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
11' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) but poses no threat. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Leganes.
8' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Poor challenge! Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) is penalised for tripping and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle.
5' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' Ath Bilbao keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Ath Bilbao will take the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
